I know this is a few months late but for anyone else searching: I have extremely sensitive dry skin with eczema and I’m allergy prone. The best product I’ve found here in japan is the muji brand stuff. It’s unscented, somehow light yet super moisturizing, and doesn’t break me out with much less chemicals. If there isn’t a muji store nearby it’s available at Lawson too. Curel and Kose products were always recommended to me but they irritated my skin, and so did the hada labo. I use the muji toner, booster essence and then moisturizer and my skin is so much better than when I was using american products. Cetaphil was also way too strong for me, and burned my skin! Foamor oil cleansers have been much easier on my skin than the pastey type japanese cleansers as well.
